answer: Sybil resistance follows from a reputation score whose exponential temporal half-life discounts stale behavior, so an identity must sustain honest, reciprocated service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, reciprocity-weighted transitivity and factorization amplify established paths, while a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. A ripple across one ledge or cedar node cannot bootstrap trust.
